name: inspect_episode_video
summary: Inspect bounded, time-indexed video intervals as actual image attachments for post-evaluation diagnosis.

generality.rationale: Uses recorded RGB motion without object-specific or manipulation-specific assumptions, but requires file-backed recordings and host image attachments.
assumptions: A supervisor-scoped video recording and FFmpeg tools are available.
limitations: Sparse RGB frames cannot establish force, hidden contact, measured arrival, or native success.
No synchronized multi-view or command-to-video alignment is inferred.
tested_tasks: robotwin/press-stapler-aloha-agilex (archived Iter3 and new Qwen3.8-Max integration validation)

level.rationale: One deterministic scoped evidence extraction with selectable temporal interval and bounded visual attachments.

provenance.failure_gap: Diagnosis from the final frame confused an intended retreat with failure to reach an earlier press target.
evidence: Iter3 diagnosis saw only the final scene and interpreted final retreat joints as evidence that the press never occurred.
